stem.text: The Haber process is carried out with a nitrogen partial pressure of $50\,\text{kPa}$, a hydrogen partial pressure of $150\,\text{kPa}$, a temperature of $400\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ and an iron catalyst.
If all other conditions are kept the same, which change will result in a raised activation energy?

A.text: Both the nitrogen and hydrogen partial pressures are changed to $100\,\text{kPa}$.

C.text: The nitrogen partial pressure is increased to $150\,\text{kPa}$.
